title: Wall Street Up After Trade Truce
text:
Wall Street Up After Trade Truce Video Credit: Wochit Business - Duration: 00:48s - Published 6 hours ago Donald Trump Wall Street Up After Trade Truce
(Reuters) - U.S. stock index futures jumped around 2 percent on Monday, setting Wall Street up to add to last week’s strong gains, after the United States and China declared a temporary trade truce.
Traders work on the floor at the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in New York City, U.S., November 30, 2018.
REUTERS/Brendan McDermid Strong gains in Apple Inc (AAPL.O) and other technology stocks pushed Nasdaq futures NQc1 up more than 2 percent, while S&P 500 e-minis ESc1 touched a near 1-month high. 0
